edits.old: The classic multiplanner runs candidates in a bounded round-robin trial and chooses the highest trial score. MongoDB's documented classic formula is base 1 + advanced / works + EOF bonus + tie-break bonuses; works count logical execution steps, not elapsed milliseconds. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20)
edits.new: The classic multiplanner runs candidates in a bounded round-robin trial (each round works every candidate once, up to a per-plan works limit, stopping when a plan hits EOF or returns enough results) and prefers the plan with the highest trial score. At source revision 35647d07 the score is base 1 + productivity (advanced / works) + tie-break bonuses (noFetch, noSort, noIxisect), plus special-case bonuses; works count calls to work(), one unit each, not elapsed milliseconds. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/35647d07bc4bc11966c90fe7100eb1db0b0ac1d9/src/mongo/db/exec/classic/multi_plan.cpp ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/35647d07bc4bc11966c90fe7100eb1db0b0ac1d9/src/mongo/db/query/plan_ranker.cpp ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/35647d07bc4bc11966c90fe7100eb1db0b0ac1d9/src/mongo/db/query/plan_ranker.h ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-plans.md
